b: Rockler has kicked off their Black Friday 2026 woodworking tool deals, and with it a new Bessey K Body REVOlution parallel clamp deal.
In no uncertain terms, I feel Bessey K Body REVOlution clamps are the best parallel clamps you can get. This deal is always an excellent buy.
Rockler’s Black Friday deal varies year to year. This year’s deal set gives you 2x 24″ clamps, 2x 50″ clamps, and 2x clamp extenders.

At the time of this posting, coupon code ONE20 gives you 20% off 1 regular price item and free shipping on $99+ orders. Since the set is discounted, you don’t get extra savings, but you do still get free ground shipping.
I love the 24″ clamps for smaller projects, and 50″ clamps for larger ones. I do also own 40″ clamps, but 50″ clamps are sometimes easier to use since I can stand them up and lean them over easier.
Even the 24″ clamps are a bit bulky and heavy – such is the nature of parallel clamps. They’re sturdy and easy to use.
Rockler’s Bessey deals tend to sell out every year, and there are always folks that miss it. You should have some time to think it over, but don’t take too long.
Amazon has the same Bessey clamp set at $214 right now. Acme Tools has the same clamp set at $314, plus special handling due to the size.
Home Depot has the 24″ clamp at $57 each, and the 50″ clamp at $68 each.
